annotations.title: Find tracks like an AINSOF track

description: Find AINSOF cues that sound like an AINSOF cue — the whole cue, or a passage of it marked with from and to (seconds, 5–60 s long), e.g. the hook or the bar before the drop. Each result names the matching passage inside it. Takes a track_id or the cue's title. For a song by another artist (a YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music or Deezer link) use search_by_reference instead.

from.description: Start of the marked passage, in seconds. Omit for the whole cue.

to.description: End of the marked passage, in seconds (5–60 s after from).

name: find_similar
